name: Alibi
kurzbeschreibung: Escape to Sankt Anton am Arlberg Sankt Anton am Arlberg isn’t just a paradise for skiers and snowboarders—it’s also the perfect alibi for those who crave adventure, relaxation…
beschreibung: The **Alibi** in **Sankt Anton am Arlberg** is a cozy pub with authentic ambiance and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Locals and visitors alike gather here to enjoy a cool beer or a fine glass of wine as the evening unfolds. The menu features classic pub favorites and regional delicacies, all freshly prepared. The rustic yet inviting interior, with comfortable seating, creates a relaxed vibe that invites you to stay awhile. Whether you're looking for an after-work drink, a cozy night out with friends, or simply want to soak in the lively scene, **Alibi** is the go-to spot for convivial moments in **Sankt Anton am Arlberg**.
